title: Beef and Baked Bean Stew
description: A slow-cooked beef stew with carrots, onion and potatoes in a rich beef stock, finished with baked beans.

ingredients.text: 500g diced stewing beef, all visible fat removed
700ml beef stock (1 very low-salt beef stock cube dissolved in 700ml boiling water) (use
2 tbsp Henderson’s relish or Worcestershire sauce
sea salt and freshly ground black pepper

steps: Spray a lidded frying pan (ovenproof if possible, but a regular frying pan is fine) with low-calorie cooking spray, add the beef and brown over a medium heat for 2–3 minutes, turning the pieces halfway through so they colour evenly. If your frying pan isn’t ovenproof, transfer the beef to an ovenproof casserole dish.
Add the pepper, carrot, onion, potatoes, 700ml beef stock, stock pot and Henderson’s relish to the casserole dish or pan.
Add the baked beans, stir, cover and put in the oven for 3 hours.
Remove the lid and cook for a further 30 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper and serve.
